osm_tags.description: Landing and takeoff to only be conducted between the second and third bridge piers, near the center of the river channel. Structural remnants of the original swing bridge pier are located between the first and second existing piers (Fort Benton side).
osm_tags.description_2: Pilots planning to operate into FTB-CC (79S) or on the Missouri River near Fort Benton are advised to contact the airport manager at 4o6-781-9478.

osm_tags.description: Steamboat remains at the bottom of the river in this area, Can be a hazard if river is very low.
osm_tags.seamark:name: Steamboat Remains
